⚠️ THE FINDING: 21 traditions each carried an L1 '-Sense' ability at ENERGY 3, MAGNITUDE 3, with the IDENTICAL three-rank arc — sense the thing · sense more of it or at range · sense all of it at once. Stone-Read, Body-Read, Chaos-Sense, Lifesense, Way-Sense, Hour-Sense, Order-Sense, Numen-Sense, Lightsense, Deathsense, Mechanism-Sense, Appetite-Sense, Fault-Sense, Read the Fight. ⛔ ONE SKILL WRITTEN TWENTY-ONE TIMES WITH THE NOUN CHANGED — the same fault as the three navigation skills, at seven times the scale.

echo_sense.name: Echo Sense
echo_sense.narrationHints: Sound-based perception like echolocation — hearing shapes, movement, and hollow spaces through walls and darkness.
echo_sense.description: Perceive your surroundings through sound reflection — even through walls, smoke, or darkness.
echo_sense.notFor: Reading emotion, intent, or words on a page; anything at true distance (beyond ~50 paces); seeing color or light-based detail.

tree.name: Near Echo
tree.grants: Map bodies and large objects through one wall or in darkness within ~10 paces; count people; sense sudden movement behind you.
tree.cannot: No fine detail (a face, a small tool); one wall only; loud environments blind it.

tree.name: Carried Echo
tree.grants: Range ~30 paces and two walls; distinguish individuals you know by gait and breath; overhear muffled speech as rhythm and tone (not words); sense hollow spaces and hidden voids.
tree.cannot: Still cannot resolve words reliably; running water scrambles it.

tree.name: Deep Listening
tree.grants: Hear actual words through barriers at ~20 paces; read a building's whole layout in a minute of stillness; detect the sub-sound of active nanite fields and Precursor machinery.
tree.cannot: Requires stillness — cannot deep-listen while moving or fighting; Precursor tech notices being listened to.

address_sense.name: Address-Sense
address_sense.peril: Reading the coordinate layer too long unmoors the reader — repeated use risks a drift toward abstract, away from the concrete present.
address_sense.narrationHints: The world briefly shows its addressing — every thing sitting at a coordinate it cannot not-occupy. Places and people as fixed points in a field that hums.

address_sense.notFor: Changing what you read (this is perception only); reading intent or future (only the standing vector); the gray water, which addresses to nowhere.

tree.name: The Standing Vector

tree.cannot: One target at a time; the read fades when you look away; people resist unless still and willing.

tree.name: The Address Itself

tree.cannot: The address is felt, not spoken — you can navigate to it but not name it; the drift-cost compounds; the Precursors' own addresses read as holes in the field.

the_true_figure.name: The True Figure
the_true_figure.narrationHints: You see the shape a thing is actually making — the pattern under the mess, the geometry a crowd is unknowingly standing in, the figure a set of events describes. Once seen, it cannot be unseen.
the_true_figure.description: Look at a scene, a record, a route, a crowd, a wound-pattern, and the craft names one thing: the element that does not fit, or the place where a piece is missing. The Figurists' first craft — pattern read rather than imposed.
the_true_figure.notFor: Patterns that are not there (the craft returns nothing rather than obliging you); reading intent or meaning; anything genuinely random.

tree.name: The Shape Under It
tree.grants: Look at a scene, a set of records, a route, a crowd, a wound-pattern — and the craft NAMES ONE THING for you: the element that does not fit, or the place where a piece is missing and what shape it must be. One concrete answer, pointed at: this ledger entry, that stone, the fourth man, the room nobody uses.
tree.cannot: It shows the SHAPE, never the reason. And a genuinely chaotic thing has no figure — it returns nothing, which Figurists insist is a real answer.

tree.name: The Continued Line
tree.grants: Extend the figure — where the pattern goes next, what the missing piece must be, where the sixth one will be found.
tree.cannot: The extension is only as sound as the figure, and a partial pattern extends confidently and wrongly. Say which you have.

tree.name: The Whole Figure
tree.grants: The complete shape of a large thing — a campaign, a season of disappearances, a city's flow, a tradition's drift.
tree.cannot: ⚠ A LARGE FIGURE IS HARD TO STOP SEEING. Figurists at this rank read pattern into things that have none, and the craft cannot tell them apart from inside.

intensity.surge: the whole figure; IT IS HARD TO STOP SEEING, and the craft cannot tell you when there is none

deathsense.narrationHints: A quiet knowing of what has died, is dying, or is near its end nearby.
deathsense.description: Sense death and dying around you — the living whose thread is fraying, the near-gone, the actively failing. Deathsense reads what is HAPPENING NOW. For what has already finished, Palework reads the evidence.
deathsense.notFor: It reads endings; it does not cause them. And it cannot see the future of a death — only the shape of the one already underway.

tree.name: Deathsense
tree.grants: Feel where a living thing is dying or near death. Judge how far along they are. Sense the failing in a person or creature before it shows on the outside.
tree.cannot: Reads the living and the dying, not the already-dead. A corpse has nothing left to sense.

tree.name: The Long Count
tree.grants: Sense not only that something living is dying but HOW — the cause, the shape, roughly how long. A body tells its ending to the Ashwarden before it tells anyone else.
tree.cannot: Knowing the hour does not give you the power to move it, and it will not let you unknow it.

tree.name: The Hour Known
tree.grants: The dying stands plain: you perceive its cause, its trajectory, and what would turn it aside — if anything would. The Ashwarden reads a living thing's end as clearly as its beginning, and can say aloud what is present in them right now.
tree.cannot: Some endings have no turning-aside. Deathsense does not make endings negotiable; it makes them visible.

deathsense.schoolAffinityNote: SNG-193: natively expressed through this school. NOT a gate — any school of the tradition can learn it, and learning it against your school's grain is where braids come from.

rankDeltas.delta: sense not only THAT something is dying but HOW — the cause, the shape, roughly how long
SPECIAL: the dying stands PLAIN — cause, trajectory, and WHAT WOULD TURN IT ASIDE, if anything would

intensity.conserve: a glance at the failing — half the detail, no weight
intensity.surge: double the read; KNOWING THE HOUR DOES NOT GIVE YOU THE POWER TO MOVE IT

bounds.text: reads the LIVING AND THE DYING, not the already-dead
KNOWING THE HOUR DOES NOT GIVE YOU THE POWER TO MOVE IT
SOME ENDINGS HAVE NO TURNING-ASIDE

deathsense.plainly: A investigate/puzzle action that reveals information or sets up a later action. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10, and lasts for about an hour. Range is 20. Ranks: rank 2 deepens precision; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: reads the Living And The Dying, not the already-dead.

lifesense.name: Lifesense
lifesense.narrationHints: The warmth of the living felt like heat through a wall — who is near, how strong their spark.
lifesense.description: Sense living things nearby — number, vigor, hidden presence.
lifesense.notFor: Reading thoughts; distinguishing individuals by identity.

tree.name: Lifesense
tree.grants: Perceive living things through walls and dark — how many, where, and how strong; judge their vigor; notice one holding still to avoid being found.
tree.cannot: Vigor, not identity; the barely-alive read faint.

tree.name: The Green Read
tree.grants: Read the whole living field of a place — what is thriving, what is failing, what is merely holding on.
tree.cannot: It reports vitality, not virtue. A thriving thing may be thriving on something you love.

tree.name: The Whole Living Field
tree.grants: Feel every living thing for a great distance as one continuous fabric, and feel where it is torn.
tree.cannot: You cannot stop feeling it. Rootkin at this depth grieve forests the way others grieve people.

rankDeltas.delta: read the whole LIVING FIELD of a place — what thrives, what fails, what merely holds on
every living thing for a GREAT DISTANCE as one continuous fabric — and where it is TORN

intensity.conserve: a quick read — half the range, no lingering
intensity.surge: double the reach; at this depth you cannot stop feeling it

bounds.text: VIGOR, NOT IDENTITY — the barely-alive read faint
it reports VITALITY, NOT VIRTUE — a thriving thing may be thriving on something terrible

appetite_sense.name: Appetite-Sense
appetite_sense.narrationHints: You can feel the shape of what they are hungry for before they say a word.
appetite_sense.description: Sense the true want under the presented want — the first gift of the Descent.
appetite_sense.notFor: Reading facts (that is Verity); reading feeling (that is Pathos). This reads HUNGER.

tree.name: Appetite-Sense
tree.grants: Feel what a person actually wants, beneath what they are asking for.
tree.cannot: It reads want, not intent. What they will DO about the want is a different craft.

tree.name: The Hollow Read
tree.grants: Feel the want a person is refusing to admit to themselves — the one doing the most work.
tree.cannot: Knowing the want they deny is a weapon, and it is very hard not to use it.

tree.name: The Whole Hunger
tree.grants: Read the appetite of a crowd, a faction, a city — what the whole thing is actually reaching for.
tree.cannot: A crowd's hunger is not the sum of its people's. It is stupider and much stronger.

rankDeltas.delta: feel the want A PERSON IS REFUSING TO ADMIT TO THEMSELVES — the one doing the most work
read the appetite of A CROWD, A FACTION, A CITY — what the whole thing is actually reaching for

intensity.conserve: a read of the want — half the depth, and it stays surface
intensity.surge: double it; KNOWING THE WANT THEY DENY IS A WEAPON, and it is very hard to un-know

bounds.text: IT READS WANT, NOT INTENT — what they will DO about it is their own

A CROWD'S HUNGER IS NOT THE SUM OF ITS PEOPLE'S — it is its own thing

the_read_want.name: The Read Want
the_read_want.narrationHints: You see what someone actually wants, which is reliably not what they are asking for. The Bargainers' whole trade rests on this and they will tell you so without embarrassment.
the_read_want.description: Look at a person in conversation and see the want beneath the request — the man asking for money who wants to be taken seriously, the one asking for justice who wants an apology. The Bargainers' first craft: read the want before naming the price.
the_read_want.notFor: Reading anything but WANT (not plans, not lies, not history); people who genuinely want nothing; using it without their knowing you can — Bargainers announce it.

tree.name: The Want Under It
tree.grants: Look at a person in conversation and see the want beneath the request — the man asking for money who wants to be taken seriously, the one asking for justice who wants an apology.
tree.cannot: It reads WANT and nothing else. The self-deceived read as they believe themselves, which is often the useful thing anyway. Someone who wants nothing gives you nothing.

tree.name: The Table Read
tree.grants: Read a room of them, or read one deeply enough to see which want they would trade the others for.
tree.cannot: Knowing the want does not tell you what it is WORTH to them, and the two are different numbers. A wrong guess at price after a right read of want is the classic Bargainer failure.

tree.name: The Whole Appetite
tree.grants: A person's wants entire and in order, including the ones they have never said out loud and the one they would be ruined by getting.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU NOW KNOW SOMETHING ABOUT THEM THEY DO NOT KNOW, and the Bargainers' own rule is that you name what you read before you trade on it. Trading on an unannounced read is the thing that gets a Bargainer refused at every table in the foothills.

intensity.conserve: read the surface want
intensity.surge: the whole appetite; NAME WHAT YOU READ BEFORE YOU TRADE ON IT

bounds.text: reads WANT and nothing else
the self-deceived read as they BELIEVE themselves
knowing the want does not tell you the PRICE

the_read_want.plainly: A social/puzzle action that reads what someone actually wants. Rated 6 of 10 on one target for about three hours.
the_read_want._descriptionWas: The Bargainers' first craft: read the want before naming the price, because a price against the wrong want is an insult.

the_read_hunger.name: The Read Hunger
the_read_hunger.narrationHints: Everything that eats has a shape to its eating. You read it — what this thing wants, how badly, what it will cross to get it, and what it will not.
the_read_hunger.description: The Abyssal Choir's first craft, and the reason they survive down there. You do not negotiate with an appetite you have not read.
the_read_hunger.notFor: Reading thought, plan, or loyalty (only APPETITE); the genuinely sated; changing anything; anything with no want at all — a machine, a corpse, a Stopped thing.

tree.name: The Shape of Its Eating
tree.grants: Read one creature, person, or thing-that-wants and the craft NAMES it: what it hungers for, how strongly, what it will risk, and the one thing it will not do even hungry.
tree.cannot: APPETITE ONLY — it tells you nothing about plans, loyalties or what it knows. The truly sated read as empty and are the most dangerous thing in the room for exactly that reason.

tree.name: The Fed and the Starving
tree.grants: Read a group or a place — which of them is hungriest, which is nearly full, and where in a warren the eating happens.
tree.cannot: Reading a room of appetites is nauseating and it lingers. And knowing what a thing wants is not knowing you can supply it.

tree.name: The Great Appetite
tree.grants: Something large — a deep thing, a host, a place's whole hunger — read entire, including the want under the want.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT NOTICES BEING READ AT THIS DEPTH. You have introduced yourself, and the Devouring find being understood almost as satisfying as being fed.

intensity.conserve: read one appetite
intensity.surge: the great appetite; IT NOTICES BEING READ AT THIS DEPTH

bounds.text: APPETITE ONLY — no plans, loyalties or knowledge
the truly SATED read as empty
knowing the want is not being able to supply it

the_read_hunger.plainly: A puzzle/social action that names what a thing hungers for and what it will risk. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about three hours.

fault_sense.name: Fault-Sense
fault_sense.narrationHints: He looks at the thing and sees where it is already halfway to failing.
fault_sense.description: See where a thing is failing, or wants to — the first gift of the Unmade.
fault_sense.notFor: Seeing what should be built (Maker's-Eye); mending.

tree.name: Fault-Sense
tree.grants: See where a structure, plan, or relationship is under stress and where it will give.
tree.cannot: Seeing the fault does not tell you whether to press it.

tree.name: The Rotten Beam
tree.grants: Find the ONE piece whose failure brings the rest — the keystone of the collapse.
tree.cannot: Finding it makes you responsible for knowing it. You cannot un-know where the keystone is.

tree.name: The Whole Failing
tree.grants: Read the entire arc of a thing's decline — how it will end, in what order, and how long it has.
tree.cannot: You will be right, and nobody will want to hear it, and it will end exactly as you said.

mechanic.note: PHYSICAL attribute — the unmaker reads stress in the body of a thing

rankDeltas.delta: find THE ONE PIECE whose failure brings the rest — THE KEYSTONE OF THE COLLAPSE

intensity.surge: double the read; YOU WILL BE RIGHT, AND NOBODY WILL WANT TO HEAR IT

the_true_feeling.name: The True Feeling
the_true_feeling.narrationHints: She knew what the room was feeling before anyone spoke.
the_true_feeling.description: Read what is actually felt — not what is shown, what is present.

tree.name: The Actual State
tree.grants: Feel the true emotional state of a person or room — not what is displayed, what is actually present underneath it.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — track a feeling over time — follow grief, find where fear developed, trace the emotional mark a person left in those they touched; it reads WHAT IS FELT, not what is TRUE.

tree.name: The Feeling Trail
tree.grants: Track a feeling over time — follow grief, find where fear developed, trace the emotional mark a person left in those they touched.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — read the feeling-truth of a whole history — what a place carries, what a people have been running from, what a person has felt for years without naming; it reads WHAT IS FELT, not what is TRUE.

tree.name: The Emotional History
tree.grants: Read the feeling-truth of a whole history — what a place carries, what a people have been running from, what a person has felt for years without naming.

see_the_made_thing.name: See the Made Thing
see_the_made_thing.narrationHints: She saw the seams in everything. That was the price of the craft.
see_the_made_thing.description: Read what is constructed versus what is found — see the falsecrafts in any situation.

tree.name: The Construction
tree.grants: Read any falsehood or illusion's construction — see how it was made, what it is made of, where it will fail.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 2 adds — see all the falsecrafts in a situation simultaneously — who is building what version of events, what holds, what is already cracking under its own weight; it reads CONSTRUCTION, not truth.

tree.name: All the Seams
tree.grants: See all the falsecrafts in a situation simultaneously — who is building what version of events, what holds, what is already cracking under its own weight.
tree.cannot: Anything rank 3 adds — read what is being constructed before it completes — see the lie before it is fully told, the illusion before it has fully taken shape; it reads CONSTRUCTION, not truth.

tree.name: The Unfinished Lie
tree.grants: Read what is being constructed before it completes — see the lie before it is fully told, the illusion before it has fully taken shape.
tree.cannot: Nothing further; this is the craft's ceiling; it reads CONSTRUCTION, not truth.

rankDeltas.delta: see ALL the falsecrafts in a situation SIMULTANEOUSLY — who is building what version of events, what holds, what is already cracking

the_plain_seeing.name: The Plain Seeing
the_plain_seeing.narrationHints: You look at a thing and what is actually so about it is simply available. Not detection, not deduction — the removal of everything that was in the way, including what you were hoping.
the_plain_seeing.description: Look at a scene, object, document, wound or room and illusion, disguise and staging come off it — you are told plainly what was added and what was moved. The Verists' first craft, and the one every other Verist craft rests on.
the_plain_seeing.notFor: Seeing what is HIDDEN (this strips distortion, it does not open locked boxes); the future; another person's interior; comfort.

tree.name: The Cleared Look
tree.grants: Look at a scene, an object, a document, a wound, a room. Illusion, disguise and staging come off it — you are told plainly WHAT WAS ADDED and what was moved: this blood was poured, that seal is recent, this man is not who he is dressed as. ⚠ It also strips what YOU were hoping to find, which in practice means it will contradict you.
tree.cannot: It removes DISTORTION, not concealment — a genuinely hidden thing stays hidden. And it strips YOUR preferences too, which is the part Verists warn apprentices about.

tree.name: The Held Clarity
tree.grants: Keep it up while you work through a place, or turn it on a person's account and see where the account and the world part company.
tree.cannot: Sustained plain seeing is exhausting in a way that is not only energy. A Falsecraft worker can feel it running and will adjust.

tree.name: The Unobstructed
tree.grants: Nothing between you and what is so — a whole site, a whole affair, a whole person's situation, entire.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU DO NOT GET TO CHOOSE WHAT YOU SEE. Verists at this rank learn things about people they love, and about themselves, that they cannot un-see and cannot honestly pretend away.

intensity.surge: the unobstructed; YOU DO NOT GET TO CHOOSE WHAT YOU SEE

the_plain_seeing._descriptionWas: The Verists' first craft and the one every other Verist craft rests on. You cannot say the true thing until you can see it.

numen_sense.name: Numen-Sense
numen_sense.narrationHints: The weight of meaning in a place felt on the skin.
numen_sense.description: Sense where meaning runs dense — sacred ground, a charged moment, a numinous site.

tree.name: Numen-Sense
tree.grants: Feel the significance-density of a place or moment; know where the world is 'thin.'
tree.cannot: Feel, not command; barren places read empty.

tree.name: The Thinning
tree.grants: Feel where the veil is thin — where meaning presses close enough to touch, and where something is pressing back.
tree.cannot: Feeling the thin place is not surviving it. Not everything on the other side is glad to be noticed.

tree.name: The Numen Plain
tree.grants: The numinous is simply visible to you — the sacred, the haunted, the charged, all plain as furniture.
tree.cannot: Once seen, never unseen. The Numinous who reach this depth find the ordinary world thin and hard to care about.

way_sense.name: Way-Sense
way_sense.narrationHints: He knows which way, and does not know how he knows.
way_sense.description: Know where you are, where things lie, and the true way between — the first gift of the Open Reach.
way_sense.notFor: Reading time; knowing what waits at the far end.

tree.name: Way-Sense
tree.grants: Never be lost. Know your bearing, your distance, and the shape of the way ahead.
tree.cannot: Knowing the way is not knowing what is on it.

tree.name: The Read Road
tree.grants: Read a route's true cost before walking it — where it will be hard, where it will be watched, where it lies.
tree.cannot: A read road is still a road. It does not walk itself.

tree.name: The Whole Map
tree.grants: Hold a region entire in your sense of it — every way in, every way out, every gap between the ways.
tree.cannot: Regions change. The map you hold is the one you built, and it ages.

hour_sense.name: Hour-Sense
hour_sense.narrationHints: She knows how long it has been, and how long it has left.
hour_sense.description: Know duration truly — how long since, how long until — the first gift of the Kept Reach.
hour_sense.notFor: Knowing WHAT will happen. This knows WHEN.

tree.name: Hour-Sense
tree.grants: Know exactly how long since a thing happened, and how long until a thing due will come.
tree.cannot: When, never what. The hour is knowable; the event is not.

tree.name: The Long Count
tree.grants: Read the age of a place, a wound, a working, or a lie — and when it will fail.
tree.cannot: It counts. It does not care whether you are ready.

tree.grants: Hold the whole duration of a place or a people — its beginning, its hours, and the hour it is running out of.
tree.cannot: Knowing a people's remaining hours and being unable to say so is the Hourkeepers' particular grief.

read_the_fight.name: Read the Fight
read_the_fight.narrationHints: The shape of the coming violence, seen a beat early.
read_the_fight.description: Read a fight's flow, a foe's next move, the moment before it breaks.
read_the_fight.notFor: Winning it for you; non-combat reads.

tree.name: Read the Fight
tree.grants: See a fight's shape and a foe's tell a beat early; know when violence is about to erupt.
tree.cannot: Reads, not wins; the truly wild are harder to call.

tree.name: The Whole Field
tree.grants: Read every fighter at once — who is committed, who is looking for the door, where the line will fail first.
tree.cannot: Reading the fight is not surviving it. The field tells you where it breaks, not how to be elsewhere.

tree.name: Three Moves Ahead
tree.grants: See the fight's shape before it takes it — where this ends, and the two or three ways it could end otherwise.
tree.cannot: Seeing the end does not mean you can choose it. The Marchers say the field always keeps one move back.

read_the_room.name: Read the Room
read_the_room.narrationHints: Every unspoken tension in a room, felt at once.
read_the_room.description: Sense a room's tensions, alliances, and the true temperature under the words.

tree.name: Read the Room
tree.grants: Read the social tensions and true feeling in a gathering; find who's about to break the peace.
tree.cannot: Reads, not calms; the disciplined mask well.

tree.name: The Room's True Weather
tree.grants: Read what a room is actually doing under what it is saying — the alliance forming, the grudge about to speak.
tree.cannot: It reads the room, not the world. What is decided elsewhere arrives regardless of how well you read this table.

tree.name: The Thing Nobody Said
tree.grants: Name the thing everyone in the room is carefully not saying — and know what will happen if it is said.
tree.cannot: Knowing it and saying it are different acts, and the second one is rarely free.

storykeeper.name: Storykeeper
storykeeper.narrationHints: The one who holds the valley's memory out loud. A story for every stone, and the discipline to keep them straight.
storykeeper.description: Hold, recall, and deploy the valley's stories — living memory as a working tool.
storykeeper.notFor: Reading (this is oral craft); knowing what nobody ever told anyone; lying — a storykeeper's coin is accuracy.

tree.name: Long Memory
tree.grants: Recall any story you've heard verbatim; know the common lore of any valley place or family; earn welcome in a strange hall by performing.
tree.cannot: Recall is of what you've HEARD — gaps are gaps; welcome isn't trust.

tree.name: The Threads Between
tree.grants: Cross-reference stories to surface what they jointly imply (codex synergy: +insight when a known topic is in play); notice when a live account contradicts the record; a told story can steady a shaken group.
tree.cannot: Implication isn't proof; steadying works once per group per trouble.

tree.name: Keeper of the Deep Stock
tree.grants: Access the old stratum — pre-crisis stories most keepers lost; recognize when events are RHYMING with an old story and read the pattern forward; your tellings enter the community record with weight.
tree.cannot: The old stratum is fragmentary and the GM holds its gaps; pattern-rhyme is probabilistic, never prophecy.

rankDeltas.delta: CROSS-REFERENCE stories to surface WHAT THEY JOINTLY IMPLY (+insight when a known topic is in play)
SPECIAL: access THE OLD STRATUM — pre-crisis stories most keepers lost; recognize when events are RHYMING WITH AN OLD STORY

intensity.conserve: recall what you heard — half the cross-reference, and it costs nothing
intensity.surge: double it; IMPLICATION ISN'T PROOF

bounds.text: recall is of WHAT YOU HAVE HEARD — gaps are gaps
IMPLICATION ISN'T PROOF
the old stratum is FRAGMENTARY and the GM holds its gaps

storykeeper.plainly: A investigate/social action that reveals information or sets up a later action. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10, and lasts for about an hour Ranks: rank 2 deepens implication; rank 3 adds to special. Limit: recall is of What You Have Heard — gaps are gaps.

keen_appraisal.name: Keen Appraisal
keen_appraisal.narrationHints: The glance that inventories a room. Worth, wear, provenance, and the one thing that doesn't belong.
keen_appraisal.description: See what's actually there: value, provenance, condition, and the detail everyone else missed.
keen_appraisal.notFor: Speed-reading people's intent (objects and scenes, not minds); magic-sense; appraising the truly unique without comparables.

tree.name: True Worth
tree.grants: Price goods accurately at a glance; spot forgery, shoddy work, and hidden damage; notice the one detail out of place in a scene.
tree.cannot: Exotic and Precursor items read as 'beyond scale'; the detail is noticed, not explained.

tree.name: Provenance
tree.grants: Read an object's history from wear (who used it, how, how long); estimate any collection's worth in minutes; spot a concealed item on a person by how they carry.
tree.cannot: History is inference — deliberate aging can fool a first read; carrying-reads need line of sight.

tree.name: Nothing Hidden
tree.grants: One sweep of a room yields its full inventory including the concealed (GM names what's findable); appraise the priceless by structural logic; your valuation is accepted as expert in any market.
tree.cannot: The sweep is once per location per visit; some Precursor concealment is beyond craft.
